title: RO pretreatment for Purified Water systems | Aquemi
meta: PVC pretreatment for your Purified Water package. It takes municipal or well drinking water and holds RO feed to chlorine, hardness and SDI targets all year.
headline: Keep chlorine and scale off your membranes
lead: We design the polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pretreatment from your seasonal feed water data. It protects the reverse osmosis (RO) membranes all year.
primary_cta_intent: I have water data, no system yet|Feed water review

stages.d: City or well drinking water that changes with the season.
Protects the public supply and buffers flow.
Removes turbidity and particles that raise the silt density index (SDI).
Removes hardness so membranes don't scale.
Removes chlorine and chloramine, which oxidize RO membranes.
Catches fines from the beds before the RO.

Hardness and alkalinity, highest in groundwater

blocks.intro: Your proposal states each option's effect on drawings, tests and lead time.

items.q: Can you replace our existing pretreatment?
items.a: Yes, on makes and equipment confirmed when you enquire. We assess the system and replace the train; the existing pretreatment runs until cutover.

items.q: Our water meets drinking water standards. Why is that not enough?
items.a: Those standards protect people, not membranes. Chlorine and chloramine that are safe to drink still damage reverse osmosis membranes.

items.q: How do you show the design covers seasonal changes?
items.a: In the design basis, month by month. We take the history you have of utility and site data and size every bed for each parameter's worst month, before you order.

items.q: What is replaced, and how often?
items.a: Cartridges, filter media, carbon, softener resin and salt, on intervals set from your feed water and microbial counts.
